standard.summary: 禁用近端更新（weight decay 不走 Adan 的近端算子）。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Disables the proximal update (weight decay does not go through Adan's proximal operator).
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 禁用近端更新（weight decay 的处理方式）。通常保持默认 False。

advanced_en.principle: Disables the proximal update (how weight decay is handled). Usually keep the default False.
